title: Describe the Problem
summary: Internal defect of 128 PCE Bracket Housing X240 with flange burr height at 0.32 mm and flatness at 0.09 mm rejected during milling inspection at WC-MILL-07.
content:
- 128 PCE of Bracket Housing X240 (batch B-49172) rejected during in-process inspection at WC-MILL-07 on 2026-08-03.
- Flange burr height measured 0.32 mm vs max 0.1 mm limit; Flange flatness measured 0.09 mm vs 0.05 mm limit.
- Historical inspection lots isolate failing burr height (0.32 mm) and shallow pocket depth (12.84 mm) strictly to fixture WC-MILL-07-F1, whereas WC-MILL-07-F2 produced conforming parts.

title: Root Cause Analysis
summary: Milling unit WC-MILL-07-F1 mechanical wear or calibration offset is the isolated root cause hypothesis for flange burr and flatness defects.
content:
- Hypothesis: Station/fixture WC-MILL-07-F1 mechanical degradation or alignment offset causes excessive burr height (0.32 mm vs 0.1 mm max) and pocket depth offset (-0.16 mm).
- Ruled out: Man, Method, Material, Measurement, and Environment are ruled out by matching conforming production (0.04 mm burr, 13.00 mm pocket depth) on station WC-MILL-07-F2 under identical processing conditions.
- Independent verification: Agrees. Reached Machine conclusion with 0.95 confidence independently from inspection lot segregation data.
- Missing evidence: Spindle runout measurements, fixture alignment inspection, and PM records for WC-MILL-07-F1.
